apps.name: Husk
apps.subtitle: Android app launcher for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Run Android apps on iOS: drop in an APK, tap it, and the Android app opens full-screen on a QEMU guest with hardware-accelerated display and audio. Needs JIT plus a debugger attached at runtime, so it requires a sideloading setup that can provide get-task-allow rather than a plain re-sign.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new?
- Sound for Unity and Java games
- Turn on JIT at launch with a setting (StikJIT)
- Share apps to Husk and import it (skips the file picker bugs)
- New App User Interface
- Game details for each game (screenshots, etc).

## Info
Husk's first stable release (1.0.0), is right around the corner. It will probably be the best release, fixing issues for almost all devices, but it is not out yet. This IPA may not work, and that is ok. It will be fixed soon, just open a GitHub issue
